resources.string: Restore access to the approved folder
Select exactly the previously approved folder. A different folder cannot replace the cleanup target.
PIN, biometrics, fingerprint, password, unlock method

This mode has no main PIN. An existing main PIN will be removed. Unlocking and security changes will require biometrics. If biometrics become unavailable or the key is invalidated after enrollment changes, you may lose access. Clearing app data deletes the local profile. An additional PIN, if configured, only starts cleanup and does not restore access to the old profile.
Biometrics are unavailable or cancelled. Retry; if a main PIN is configured, you can use it instead.
Ask for PIN or biometrics again
Allow capture while the app is unlocked. Off by default.

Screenshots, screen recording and screen sharing may expose application content. Saved copies are outside the app lock and may remain after cleanup. PIN and security setup screens remain protected. Enable capture only if you accept this risk.
Allow screenshots of every Slooop screen, including PIN entry

Before version 3.2.70, screenshots, recording and casting are allowed for every Slooop screen, including PIN entry, confirmations and cleanup. Do not record real codes or personal data. Saved copies may remain after cleanup. Android system restrictions are unchanged. Starting with 3.2.70, protective capture restrictions will return.
Unlock with system strong biometrics. The main app PIN remains available.
OFF by default. After security confirmation, approve the exact folder whose entire contents will be deleted when the additional PIN is entered.
Open the application to view this notification
Delete contents of the download folder

Only when the additional PIN is entered: delete ALL files and subfolders in the directory below, including files created by other apps and exported backups. The directory itself remains. This is OFF by default. Approval applies only to this directory; changing the download folder requires new approval. Local subfolders with a persisted read/write grant are supported, not volume roots or cloud providers. Deletion is not guaranteed if permission or storage becomes unavailable.
Select an available local download folder first. Volume roots and cloud folders cannot be used.
Downloaded files and external backups remain unless folder cleanup was separately enabled. Files outside the approved folder are never deleted.
The local profile was cleared, but download folder cleanup did not finish. Restore access and retry. Continuing without deletion requires security confirmation; files may remain in that folder.
Additional PIN: empty profile and cleanup
Enter the main application PIN to change security settings
Choose a new PIN. The two PINs must be different.
The PINs do not match. Enter a new PIN again.
Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
Could not save the PIN. Check that the PINs differ and try again.
Security storage is unavailable. Access remains locked.
Biometrics unavailable or cancelled. Use the main PIN.

Locks when the screen turns off or the application goes into the background, including picture-in-picture. Background playback stops. Screenshots are blocked unless separately allowed; private content is hidden when leaving the app.

Entering this PIN deletes local history and searches, open pages, my posts and reply history, bookmarks, custom boards and communities, drafts and queued messages, temporary attachments, caches and translations, video position, forum login data, cookies, saved names and email, deletion passwords, proxy addresses and credentials, and internal diagnostic logs. Background reply tracking is disabled. Appearance, PINs, biometrics, installed extensions and language models remain. Downloaded files and exported backups remain UNLESS folder cleanup was separately enabled. Forum posts and copies outside that folder are not deleted. The main PIN cannot restore deleted data. Folder permissions and folder cleanup approval are reset afterward.
Cleanup could not finish. Data remains locked. Close and reopen Slooop to retry.

This is an application lock, not encryption of existing data or protection against a compromised device. Cleanup does not guarantee forensic erasure and cannot delete copies outside its approved scope. There is no forgotten-PIN recovery; clearing app data loses the local profile. Test the additional PIN only on disposable data.
